svg.title: B1.02 · Calculate Special Bonus
svg.desc: One row per employee with their calculated bonus. An odd ID gives 1. A permitted name also gives 1. Michael fails the name test and Juan fails the ID test. IDs 7 and 9 receive 7400 and 7700. The remaining employees receive 0 and all five appear in ID order.
svg.text: One row per employee with their calculated bonus.
Michael has an odd ID. Does that alone earn a bonus?
A triangle marks an example to follow. Shaded columns show what to read. SQL excerpts use … for omitted clauses.
An odd ID gives 1. A permitted name also gives 1. Michael fails the name test and Juan fails the ID test.
employee_id % 2 AS remainder, name NOT LIKE 'M%' AS name_allowed
IDs 7 and 9 receive 7400 and 7700. The remaining employees receive 0 and all five appear in ID order.
CASE WHEN name NOT LIKE 'M%' AND employee_id % 2 = 1 THEN salary ELSE 0 END
